integrity: All mathematical statements are self-review; code is corroborative and not an infinite proof. The earliest cited paper is the mathematical starting point, not a claim of authorship. Priority outside inspected literature is uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Two permanent unweighted proxies, odd positive number of delegators, identical independent delegation propensities, unbiased binary ballots, strict majority and counterfactual a-priori pivotality only. Other network topologies, weighted voters, cycles and correlation not analyzed.
title: Sharp uniform suppression of normalized voting power with two competing proxies
